artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene featuring a detailed interior from a historical period. Multiple individuals are engaged in various activities around a table. The room has a large fireplace and lattice windows, with bustling activity. The individuals are dressed in period clothing. The interior includes woodwork, a tiled floor, benches, and a table with food and drink. Light enters through the windows, offering a view of nearby buildings. The drawing captures elements of historical daily life in a social gathering.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals, each shown from head to toe. On the left, a young person with a round face stands wearing an ornate costume with a feathered hat and holds a book. The facial features appear detailed with rosy cheeks. In the center, a woman stands gesturing towards the seated man, with her head slightly bowed and her eyes directed downward. Her hair is tightly styled, and she wears a long, flowing gown adorned with ruffled fabric around the collar and shoulders. She holds a small basket in her right hand. To the right, a bearded man, seated on a stool, faces the woman. He wears a buttoned shirt and pants, with a soft cap on his head. Both his posture and the expression on his face are suggestive of engagement in a conversation. His left hand rests on the basket in front of him, which is filled with wooden sticks or similar objects. The background consists of a simple interior with patterned flooring and a bare wall.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with a large round table at the center. Several figures are engaging in various activities around the table, while others are entering the room or occupied with different tasks. A fireplace with kitchen utensils is visible on the right. The scene is detailed, showcasing a chaotic and lively environment typical of that period's engravings.

artworks.title: Ex-Libris pour "L'Ensorcelée" (Bookplate for "L'Ensorcelée")
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette in black on moderately thick cream (discolored to light brown) laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate bookplate. It features an intricately designed archway or door with decorative elements such as statues on either side and an angelic figure at the top. In the center, there is a framed area with text inscribed on it, which says "Ex Libris." Surrounding this centerpiece are detailed depictions of foliage, a swan, and floral motifs. The drawing uses shading and cross-hatching to add depth and texture to the composition.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Lustful: Paolo and Francesca
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring swirling human forms and celestial imagery. The image includes a large spiral or vortex composed of numerous human figures in various poses, some entwined with each other. These figures seem to be flowing or rising within the spiral. Above the spiral is a radiant circular light source, with an additional smaller figure inside. On the right side, a lone figure appears to be observing the scene, standing near a lifeless body on the ground. The detailed line work gives the drawing an ethereal and dreamlike quality.

artworks.title: Voyez, Mr. Mayeux, cet animal...
artworks.description: This is a painting of a gorilla and two men in an anthropomorphic scene. The gorilla is dressed partially in human attire, seated at a table in between the two men. The man on the left wears a formal coat and a top hat, gesturing with his hand. The gorilla is wearing a top hat and the man on the right leans towards the gorilla with a hopeful expression, hands clasped together. The background shows a simple interior setting with a large square window. The painting is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Bobonne... ne le regarde pas tant!
artworks.description: This is a painting of an orangutan enclosed behind bars in the upper part of the composition, while a crowd in colorful clothing stands below, looking up with various expressions. Among the crowd are individuals in vivid attire, including a figure dressed in a colorful robe, another in striped pants holding a hat, and others wearing formal hats. The expressions on their faces range from wide-eyed amazement to comedic dismay. This is in style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Dieu de Dieu! mais c'est un pppolisson...
artworks.description: Three figures and a gorilla are indoors. One woman is seated, looking surprised, wearing a straw bonnet with black ribbons, a red shawl, and a floral dress. A gorilla is on her lap, facing away. A man with short hair wears a dark coat and grey trousers, reaching out toward the gorilla. Another man in a coat and cap observes from the left. The background is a plain light brown wall.

artworks.title: La Potion
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a chair with red cushioning, holding a glass in his right hand and a small spoon in his left hand. He wears a colorful turban with a pattern of yellow, red, and green, as well as a patterned robe over a white shirt. A bottle labeled "COPAIVA" is on the table next to him.

artworks.title: Une lecture entrainante
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated at a table. He is focused on reading a book that is open in front of him. His facial features are exaggerated with a pronounced brow, long nose, and small round spectacles. He has sparse and disheveled hair. The man is wearing a dark jacket with a high collar, and a bit of a green collar is visible beneath. On the table, there is a plate with food, a small glass of red liquid, and a wine bottle. He is holding a carafe, pouring its contents onto the plate. A white tablecloth covers the table, and the setting appears simple with a focus on the man's activity. The background is plain, emphasizing the central subject of the man and his interaction with the book and meal.

artworks.title: L'amateur d'huitres
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table, leaning forward to slurp an oyster. He has exaggerated facial features in a caricature style, with a large nose, prominent chin, and wide eyes. He has brown, combed-back hair and is wearing a dark green coat over a white and blue checkered shirt. On the table in front of him are stacks of oyster shells, a clear glass with a reddish liquid, and a bottle with a lime wedge. The background is plain and off-white.

artworks.title: Le bon morceau
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting at a table cutting into his meal with a knife and fork. His facial expressions are exaggerated, showing wide eyes and a wrinkled forehead. He has short, dark, wavy hair and is dressed in a dark jacket with a white shirt. The table has a white tablecloth and various items on it, including a glass with red liquid, a bottle, and another plate. The man is seated on a wooden chair with a curved back, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Fameuse perruque
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a side profile from his chest upward. He is standing with raised arms, holding a wig in one hand. The man has exaggerated facial features, a bald head with some hair, and is wearing a collared shirt and green trousers with a waistcoat. The background is simple and light in color with no distinct details.

artworks.title: La renommée des glaces
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on a wooden chair with his body leaning forward onto a table. He has dark, slicked-back hair, a long sideburn, and a receding hairline. The man is wearing a dark jacket with a high-collared shirt and a waistcoat. He is looking to the right with a crooked smile. On the table in front of him is a tray holding a glass, a small pitcher, and another small glass. There is a piece of paper or napkin partially covering the table. The background is plain.

artworks.title: La bonne prise
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a three-quarter view facing slightly to the right. He appears to be an older gentleman with white hair under a black top hat. His facial features include a prominent nose and a lined face. He is wearing a dark jacket over a white shirt with a high collar and a cravat or necktie. His left hand is raised to his nose and his right hand holds a small open container, likely a snuffbox. He also holds a cane, which rests between his arms. The background is a plain light tan color, with no additional elements visible. Surrounding the illustration are printed words, including "Galerie Physionomique" at the top and "La bonne prise" and "The good pinch of snuff" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Le vrai Fumeur
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the waist up, leaning back in a relaxed position. His facial features are round and his eyes appear to be half-closed. He has short, neatly combed brown hair. The man is dressed in a white shirt with a dark-colored jacket over it. In his right hand, he holds a smoking pipe, from which a cloud of smoke is elegantly drifting upwards. In his left hand, resting on a ledge, he holds a small glass. The background of the image is plain, with a subtle gradation of color. The text on the document identifies this image as part of "Galerie Physionomique" with the number "N°9" visible at the top right corner. The lower part of the image features cursive text labeling the image as "Le vrai Fumeur | A true Smoker."

artworks.title: Oh! ma femme est morte!
artworks.description: The image shows a man reading a paper. He has a round face, raised eyebrows, and a surprised or concerned expression. He has a beard and disheveled hair. He wears glasses, a white shirt, and is in the middle of shaving. On the table in front of him are a straight razor, black strap, and white plate. The background has a greenish hue on the left and a red drape on the right, possibly with a mirror. The image has an antique, illustrative quality, indicative of a historical or vintage print.

artworks.title: La carte a payer
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting at a table. He has an open right hand holding coins, exaggerated facial features, a receding hairline, and is dressed in a dark green coat over a gray waistcoat and white shirt. The table has various items on it, and there is a pitcher in the background. Text is printed in French and English at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Encore une heure!!
artworks.description: The image shows an older man's body from the waist up. He is holding a pocket watch in his left hand and gazing down at it. The man has a prominent nose and cheeks, small round spectacles, and a serious expression. He wears a tall black top hat with a cockade, a gray or off-white cloak, and a cravat with stripes. He holds a rifle with its butt resting on the ground. In the background, there is a pale pink wall with the words "MAIRIE" and "ORDRE DU JOUR."

artworks.title: First Wise Virgin
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in profile, facing right. She has long, curly hair and a detailed face. She wears a long gown, holds the fabric in one hand, and holds a chalice with a flame in the other hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint George on Foot
artworks.description: The image depicts a person wearing historical or medieval-style armor. The individual is standing upright and facing forward. The facial features are within a helmet covering most of the head. The figure wears ornate armor, including a helmet, shoulder guards, and a pleated skirt-like lower portion. The person holds a long spear or staff. The background is plain, and the image is in black and white on aged paper.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This is an image of a group of people gathered around a table for a meal. The engraving depicts intricate lines and shading, creating depth and texture. In the center, a figure with a halo is seated at a table with platters, bread, and a candle. Other individuals around the table are engaged in conversation or contemplation. The background includes architectural structures and figures, such as a building with arched windows and a person holding a basket. The scene is set within an ornate architectural frame.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with four figures in a rocky landscape. In the foreground, three figures are depicted reclining on the ground, draped in loose robes. One figure holds a sword while resting. In the background, elevated on a rocky ridge, a fourth figure kneels facing upwards, gesturing towards an ethereal figure emerging from the clouds with wings and a halo. The landscape includes twisted trees, a path, and a distant castle-like structure. The engraving technique shows intricate hatching and fine lines.

artworks.title: Christ Taken Captive
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nighttime arrest scene. The image depicts a central figure with long hair and a serene demeanor, surrounded by heavily armored individuals with weapons. One figure appears to embrace the central figure, while another individual seems to be holding a sword aggressively. The atmosphere is tense, with torches lighting the scene and hills or rocky terrain in the background. The drawing is rich in detail, showing intricate lines and shading that bring depth to the composition.
